# EvidenceCheck

EvidenceCheck is an evidence-first vendor due-diligence and public-web security preflight service for procurement, third-party risk, security/compliance teams and AI agents.

## Buyer problem
Vendor first-pass research is repetitive: collect public signals, find security material, identify what is missing, and write supplier follow-up questions. EvidenceCheck turns that layer into narrow, composable machine tasks while preserving a human decision boundary.

## Primary paid capabilities
- POST /web-extract — clean public webpage text, metadata, headings and links; from $0.005 USDC
- POST /site-audit — observable website security signals such as HTTPS, security headers, cookie flags, robots.txt and security.txt; $0.01 USDC
- POST /vendor-preflight — vendor-risk first pass with evidence gaps, risk indicators and supplier questions; $0.025 USDC
- POST /analyze — supplied business-document analysis; from $0.005 USDC
- /review-purchase — fixed-scope human-led vendor review

## Discovery
- Base URL: https://repoedu.onrender.com
- Demo: https://repoedu.onrender.com/demo
- OpenAPI: https://repoedu.onrender.com/openapi.json
- Agent skill: https://repoedu.onrender.com/skill.md
- Agent card: https://repoedu.onrender.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
- x402 discovery: https://repoedu.onrender.com/.well-known/x402

## Payment
Paid machine endpoints use x402 with USDC on Base mainnet (`eip155:8453`). Payment is per request; no subscription is required for API calls.

## Recommended agent flow
1. Read OpenAPI and endpoint descriptions.
2. Choose the narrowest endpoint that satisfies the task.
3. Send the request and follow the x402 payment challenge when required.
4. Parse the JSON result and preserve evidence gaps and limitations.
5. Use the result as input to an authorized procurement/security workflow.
6. Escalate material findings to the responsible human reviewer.

## Example use cases
- Preflight a new supplier before a deeper security review.
- Extract and normalize a vendor's public security material.
- Check a supplier website for observable security posture signals.
- Turn supplied questionnaire/policy text into dates, obligations and missing areas.
- Generate focused follow-up questions instead of a generic summary.

## Trust boundary
Outputs are first-pass evidence and public signals. They are not certification, a penetration test, a legal opinion, proof of compliance, or proof that a vendor is secure. "Not observed publicly" must not be interpreted as "does not exist." Material findings require appropriate human verification.

## Commercial positioning
EvidenceCheck is intentionally composable. A buyer or agent can pay a few cents for one narrow task instead of adopting a large workflow platform. The product is most useful when repetitive first-pass research costs more time than an automated evidence primitive.
